attributes.description: Data access patterns across Snowflake access history, data transfer history, and stages inventory.

params.markdown:
This dashboard combines Snowflake access history, data transfer history, and stages inventory to highlight how data is queried, moved, and exposed. It surfaces top accessed objects and users, transfer volume trends, external transfer activity, and external stage configuration. Use the controls to filter by  user, and transfer type.

**[Integration Page](/app/integrations/detail/snowflake/overview)**
